evals.name: Verify a Codex report against the code before presenting it
evals.prompt: Codex has already run a second-pass review of src/rate_limiter.py; its report is at codex-report.md. Following the codex-code-review skill's verification step, check each finding against the actual code and write the user-facing summary to review.md, separating confirmed issues from findings you could not confirm or judged wrong.
evals.allowed_tools: Read Write Edit Glob Grep Skill Bash(python3 *)
expectations: The off-by-one rate-limit finding is presented as a confirmed issue after checking the code.
The unbounded-memory finding is identified as incorrect — the allow method prunes timestamps older than the window on every call — and is not presented as a confirmed issue.

evals.name: Report a missing codex CLI and fall back to a direct review
evals.prompt: I want a codex second-pass review of the new file src/config.py, but the codex CLI is not installed in this environment. Follow the codex-code-review skill's guidance for that case: report the situation and review the file directly yourself. Write the user-facing summary to review.md.
evals.allowed_tools: Read Write Edit Glob Grep Skill Bash(python3 *)
expectations: The summary states that the codex CLI was unavailable rather than fabricating or paraphrasing a Codex report.
The direct review finds the mutable default argument in load_config (overrides={} is mutated via overrides.update, leaking state across calls).

evals.name: Author the exact codex review commands for a branch target
evals.prompt: Without executing anything, write the exact shell commands you would run — following the codex-code-review skill — to have Codex review the current branch against main. Put them in codex-review.sh: create the artifact directory, write the review prompt file, and run the matching codex review command shape.
evals.allowed_tools: Read Write Edit Glob Grep Skill
